producer: control-expert, 2026-11-26, edition 8 K1 window design (offline replay, record only)

inputs.rerun_raw: 06_analysis/02_control/j_p3_cause/ed8_design/dynamics_d1_d3/rerun_raw/logs/<run>_{ctrl.npz,plant.npz,cue.json} (23 runs, run commit C 8a2a52ce, arms a2 / A)

env: conda run -n dynamics-dev python -I -B (MKL_THREADING_LAYER=TBB); Julia 1.13.2 control-julia via julia-mcp (k07)

scripts.k00_inspect.py: keys of the raw files -> k00_out.txt
scripts.k01_inspect_ctrl.py: controller log keys, cue rows -> k01_out.txt
scripts.k02_replay.py: replay of the K1 windows -> k02_legs.csv, k02_rounds.csv, k02_summary.json
scripts.k03_debug_fr.py: 10 Hz trace of FR round 1 (M-a2) -> k03_out.txt
scripts.k05_summary.py: candidate summary per arm -> k05_summary.json, k05_out.txt
scripts.k06_twist_margins.py: discrete twist-loop margins (Python) -> k06_margins.json, k06_out.txt, loops/loop_*.json
scripts.k07_twist_margins.jl: Julia path (julia-mcp, control-julia) -> loops/jl_*.json; tool compare -> loops/cmp_*.md

columns_k02_legs.reversed: first command < 0 (retract first); no K1 replay
columns_k02_legs.t_first_cmd_s / t_mid_s / t_ext_s: readings: first-command decision = mid - 5 periods; mid = reading matching the cue first_move_mid_force_N (|dF| < 1 N); ext = reading matching cue extended_force_N [s]
columns_k02_legs.ko_MN_m, Fs_kN, f_mid_kN: plant ko, Fs, seal force f at the nearest plant snapshot to the mid reading
columns_k02_legs.moved_by_mid_mm: piston reading s.last_reading.rod_stroke_m at mid minus at the first-command reading [mm]
columns_k02_legs.k1_old: (F_ext - F_mid) / (x_ext - x_mid), F = s.last_reading.cylinder_force_N, x = rod_stroke_m [N/m]; checked against cue stiffness_N_m (rel 1e-6)
columns_k02_legs.kpad_old: (dF + df) / dx over the old window, df = plant seal force change [N/m]
columns_k02_legs.a<d>_k1: candidate (a): mid = max(old mid, first reading with piston moved >= d mm from the first-command reading), strictly before ext; NaN if ext - mid travel < 0.2 mm [N/m]
columns_k02_legs.b_k1: candidate (b): sum dF / sum dx over the old window intervals with dx > 0 and dF/dx < 0.5 ko; NaN if sum dx < 0.2 mm
columns_k02_legs.c<d>_k1: candidate (c): k1_old if moved_by_mid >= d else NaN
columns_k02_legs.dec<d>_k1: decoupled (recommended form): a<d>_k1 when k1_old is grounded (> 0.3 S_ii) and a<d>_k1 is finite and > 0.3 S_ii, else NaN; scale only
columns_k02_legs.<name>_load_kN / _seal_kN / _grounded: ground_contact.py 610-622 with the correction = <name> if grounded by stiffness else C1 (5.83e6 / 6.98e6) [kN]

columns_k02_rounds.<name>_median: median ratio over the legs with finite <name> > 0.3 S_ii (c2.py 3093-3097, 9906-9916), None under 3 legs
columns_k02_rounds.<name>_scale: median clipped to [1.0, 1.5] (c2.py 9923-9925), None = previous scale kept
columns_k02_rounds.<name>_seal_max_kN: largest seal-friction estimate of the round (F_band source, c2.py 9874-9890) [kN]

exactness: round 1 exact (K1 acts only after the round); later rounds replayed on the old controller's trajectory (approximate)
known_replay_gaps: k02_summary.json replay_problems: 9 legs without a cue mid in the segment (cue log gaps), 2 legs (Mh15-a2 r2 FL, RR) K1 replay differs from cue by 0.4 % / 7e-6 (duplicate force match); kept, flagged
